clips.title: The story
paras: In southern Silverpine, Shadowfang Keep shelters the rogue Kirin Tor wizard Archmage Arugal and the worgen he summoned. The old Silverlaine estate now holds feral beasts and the phantoms of its slaughtered defenders, while nearby Pyrewood Village remains bound to a horrifying curse.

Shadowfang Keep was once Silverlaine Keep, a noble seat defended by the pious Commander Springvale. During the Third War, the Scourge swept through Lordaeron and Dalaran's wizards fell in droves. Desperate to stem the rising dead, Archmage Arugal defied the Kirin Tor leadership and turned to the research of the wizard Ur. He summoned extra-dimensional worgen to turn the tide. The beasts savaged the undead, then slipped beyond mortal control and stormed southern Silverpine. Baron Silverlaine and his entire court were massacred, doomed to haunt the stone halls beside the feral monsters that overran their home.

Broken by guilt and madness, Arugal withdrew behind the blood-stained battlements. He called the ravenous wolf-men his beloved children and named the castle Shadowfang Keep. In its stone roosts, lupine packs and shadowy hounds thrive under trainers such as Wolf Master Nandos, watched by Arugal's massive lupine beast, Fenrus the Devourer. The curse did not halt at the walls. Nearby Pyrewood Village remains trapped in a horrifying nocturnal cycle: its people walk as men by day and hunt as ravenous worgen beneath the moon, bound to the mad archmage on the heights above.
